title: Remove Duplicates from Sorted Array
problem: Given an integer array sorted in non-decreasing order, remove the duplicates in-place such that each unique element appears only once. Return the number of unique elements.
constraints:
1 <= nums.length <= 3 * 10^4
nums is sorted in non-decreasing order.
hints: Use two pointers: one write pointer and one read pointer.
expected_approach: Scan the array and write unique values to the write index.
